question: What is the actual deliverable you want at the end of this run?
why: Sets how far the fleet pushes. Everything downstream scales from this answer.

Whole-Bible reader shell + full multimodal depth only for Acts
Architectural skeleton + 2-3 flagship features done to perfection, rest stubbed
recommended: Whole-Bible reader shell + full multimodal depth only for Acts

recommended: Hybrid — keep the Flutter reader/chat behaviour and quality bar, but the PRD's screens and visual language win

recommended: Bible (Reader + inline badges + sheets)
